# elves_rule (Resource)

Manages an Elves (Santa) rule. `custommessage` is what Santa shows in its block dialog on the Mac; `description`, `remediation_instructions` and `remediation_script` are only shown on the Elves rules page that the dialog's button opens.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "elves_rule" "TestCEL" {
  ruletype      = "BINARY"
  policy        = "CEL"
  identifier    = "this is test identifier"
  custommessage = "thsi is test message"
  isdefault     = true
  celexpression = "aaabbbddd"
}

resource "elves_rule" "BlockedApp" {
  ruletype   = "TEAMID"
  policy     = "BLOCKLIST"
  identifier = "EQHXZ8M8AV"
  isdefault  = true

  # Shown by Santa in the block dialog on the Mac, keep it short
  custommessage = "This app is not allowed"

  # Shown on the Elves rules page the dialog's button opens. Leave description
  # out when it would only repeat custommessage: the page then shows that.
  description              = "This app is not approved for company Macs because it uploads files to an unapproved cloud service."
  remediation_instructions = "Use the approved alternative from Self Service."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `custommessage` (String) Required. Message Santa shows in the block dialog on the Mac when this rule blocks an app. Keep it short, it has to fit the dialog.
- `identifier` (String) Required. Identifier of the binary
- `policy` (String) Required. ALLOWLIST_COMPILER, ALLOWLIST, BLOCKLIST, SILENT_BLOCKLIST or CEL
- `ruletype` (String) Required. BINARY, CERTIFICATE, TEAMID, SIGNINGID or CDHASH

### Optional

- `celexpression` (String) Optiopnal. CEL expression
- `description` (String) Optional. Longer explanation of why the app is blocked, shown on the Elves rules page that opens from the button in Santa's block dialog. Never sent to Santa. When empty, that page shows `custommessage` instead, so only set it when the page should say more than the dialog. When not set here, the value from the Elves UI is kept; set it to `""` to clear it.
- `isdefault` (Boolean) Optional. Marking rule and Default rule, default to true.
- `remediation_instructions` (String) Optional. What the user can do instead (for example an approved alternative or how to get access), shown on the Elves rules page below the description. Never sent to Santa. When not set here, the value from the Elves UI is kept; set it to `""` to clear it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of a rule in Elves
- `remediation_script` (String) Script the user can copy and run in Terminal to fix the problem, shown on the Elves rules page. Read-only: Elves only lets a logged-in admin change it in the UI, not an API key, so Terraform keeps whatever is set there.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Rule can be imported by specifying the ID of the rule.
terraform import elves_rule.example 68
```
